items.text: kya hua
abhi tak problem hai
firse complain karna hai

items.context: kya aapko lagta hai ki aapki complaint solve nahi hui hai?
items.text: bilkul sahi hai
please escalate kar do

items.context: kab tak aap chahte hain ki problem solve ho?
items.text: jaldi karna
mai ne 20 April ko complaint register karwaya tha par abhi tak koi action nahi liya gaya
mera number 9845123670 hai aur Delhi se hu maine apni service ko le kar complain kiya tha
last week bhi call kiya tha support center ko par unhone mujhe justify nahi kiya
main chahta hu ki mera complaint senior manager tak pahuch jaye aur jaldi action ho
meri lines bar bar drop ho rahi hain aur recharge bhi nahi ho pa raha hai
mujhe kal tak solution chahiye warna mai higher authority ko batana chahunga
mere billing mein galti hai magar woh abhi bhi fix nahi hui badhiya se escalate karo
yah problem kaafi din se chal rahi hai yeh jabardasti recharge fail ho raha hai

items.context: kya aap apna address verify kar sakte hain?
items.text: maine apna address Gurgaon mein diya tha lekin service wahan se nahi mil rahi hai

items.context: kya aapke paas complaint ki confirmation mili thi?
items.text: bataiye ki complaint register karte samay koi reference number mila ya nahi

items.context: kya aapne pehle kisi agent se baat ki hai is problem ke bare mein?
items.text: maine already second level support se baat ki thi par woh bhi solution nahi de pate

items.context: kya aap network issue ke baare mein thoda detail mein bata sakte hain?
items.text: mere sim se baar baar network disconnect ho jata hai aajkal se problem aur badh gayi
main Nehru Place Delhi se bol raha hu mera account number 123456789 hai aur 15 din ho gaye mujhe ab bhi apne internet connection mein dikkat aa rahi hai
maine 10 April ko recharge kiya tha 500 rupees ka par paisa deduct hone ke bawajood internet connection wapas nahi mila aur kisi ne contact bhi nahi kiya ab mujhe eskalation chahiye
mera naam Ramesh Kumar hai aur main Bangalore mein rehta hu maine pehle bhi complain ki thi ki mera mobile balance fir se khatam ho raha hai bina use kiye iska koi hal nikalo

items.context: aap kaha se call kar rahe hain aur kya problem face kar rahe hain?
items.text: mujhe 5 din se bilkul bhi signal nahi mil raha hai main ghar mein session road Jaipur se baat kar raha hu

items.context: kya aap apni complaint ka reference number share kar sakti hain?
items.text: ma'am mujhe complain karne ke baad bhi koi update nahi mila address Sector 22 Chandigarh hai aur main aapki service se bahut naraaz hu

items.context: aapko kis prakar ki billing problem face karni pad rahi hai?
items.text: main Mohit Singh Mumbai se hu aur mera ek charge 300 rupees ka do baar deduct ho gaya hai mujhe is baat ka pura jawab chahiye aur jaldi se solution bhi do

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: escalate_complaint - is unhappy that an earlier complaint was not solved and wants escalation
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
